frente.titulo: The School educates. The Front organizes.
frente.frentesTitulo: Fronts of action, on the street
frente.frentesTexto: The Front works in person: cells in the neighbourhood, at school and at work. Each militant acts in one front, agreed with the cell on Alumia. Yours is highlighted.
frente.escolher: Tap a front to choose yours. Tapping yours again removes the choice.
frente.contagem: The number on each front is how many militants act in it. Fronts with fewer than 3 people show no number.
frente.tirada: Done: you have no front chosen.
frente.ausente: Choosing your front here is not switched on yet. Agree on it with your cell.
frente.falha: Could not save right now. Try again.

assembleia.aberta: Voting on the agenda is open until {data}.
assembleia.aConfirmar: The agenda still has to be confirmed by the coordination.
assembleia.fechada: Voting for this semester is closed.
assembleia.semPauta: The coordination has not put together this semester's agenda yet.
assembleia.voto: The vote is secret and is stored only as a count.

ouvidoria.texto: Criticism, complaint or suggestion for the coordination. You follow it up with the protocol number.

dados.texto: Being a militant reveals a political opinion, which Brazilian law calls sensitive data (LGPD, art. 5, II). Only the coordination sees your registration, and you can ask for it to be deleted.

duvida.sobreAula: About lesson {codigo}. Choose who to talk to.

assistente.texto: answers right away, explains it another way

acompanha.texto: {nome} answers through the conversation on Alumia
acompanha.ninguem: the coordination will still name who accompanies you
acompanha.semConversa: {nome} has no open conversation on Alumia: bring it up at the next circle

nucleo.texto: goes on the agenda of the next circle
nucleo.semNucleo: you have no cell yet: the coordination will assign one

duvida.exemplo: I didn't understand the difference between...
duvida.escrevaDica: To take it to the cell, write the question here and tap "Take it to the cell". It goes without your name.
duvida.precisaTexto: Write the question in the field below first.
duvida.levada: Done: the question is on the agenda of the next circle, without your name.
duvida.ausente: The cell agenda does not take questions from here yet. Bring it up at the next circle.
duvida.semPermissao: Only militants with a cell can put a question on the agenda.
duvida.falha: Could not send it right now. Try again.
duvida.semEncontro: Your cell has not scheduled the next meeting yet. Bring the question once it is scheduled.
duvida.pautaCheia: The agenda for the next meeting is already full. Bring the question in person to the meeting.
duvida.tamanho: Write the question in 3 to 200 characters.
